relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.evidence: passed the Entrance (school leaving) examination from the Mutty Lal Seal's Free School (1907), ranking sixth, and the FA (pre-university examination) from the renowned Scottish Church College

relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.evidence: He did his Major (Honours) in English literature from Presidency College, Kolkata, standing first in the first class in 1911.

relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.evidence: In 1913, he completed his M.A. in English literature, again standing first. The same year, he was appointed lecturer in English at Vidyasagar College, Kolkata

relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.role: assistant professor of English in the Post-Graduate Department
relations.evidence: In 1914, Chatterji became assistant professor of English in the Post-Graduate Department of the University of Calcutta, which he held till 1919.

relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.evidence: He went abroad to study at the University of London where he studied Phonology, Indo-European Linguistics, Prakrit, Persian, Old Irish, Gothic and other languages.

relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.evidence: He then went to Paris and did research at the Sorbonne in Indo-Aryan, Slavic and Indo-European Linguistics, Greek and Latin.

relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.evidence: His teacher was the internationally acclaimed linguist, Jules Bloch.

relations.subject: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
relations.role: Khaira Professor of Indian Linguistics and Phonetics
relations.evidence: After returning to India in 1922, he joined the University of Calcutta as the Khaira Professor of Indian Linguistics and Phonetics. After retirement in 1952, he was made professor emeritus
